title: A Deadline for the Extraction
author: Rafael Halloran
blurb: Oscar Voss, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
